subject: Post-demo: feature-level cost model, $/1M tokens target, and CAC payback
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Zhao <emma@finsolve.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + ask: token volumes, $/1M target, CAC payback

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on your use cases. Quick recap and a small favor so we can turn this into a short pricing model for your CFO/procurement team.

Highlights from the demo:
- Primary features: real-time transaction summarization (Feature A), automated dispute triage (Feature B), and customer-facing chat (Feature C).
- Expected latency targets: 300–500ms P50 for chat, 150ms for summarization edge cases.
- Data residency: US-only, logs retained 90 days.

What we need from you to build a tight unit-econ model:
1) Monthly/annual token volume per feature (or % split across features). If you don’t have per-feature numbers, a single projected monthly token figure and % guess is fine.
2) Targeted cost ceiling expressed as $/1M tokens (what would feel like ‘deployable’ to your CFO).
3) CAC / payback expectations (months to payback on average new customer) or LTV:CAC target.

If you can reply with (1)-(3) by EOD Wednesday, we’ll deliver a one-page cost model + recommended packaging and a simple SOW draft for procurement. I’ve looped Jordan (sales lead) and Rishi (pricing) so they can validate assumptions.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Soojin — enjoyed the call. Answers below (rough numbers, happy to refine):

1) Token volumes (initial 12 months estimate):
- Feature A (summarization): 150M tokens / month
- Feature B (dispute triage): 40M tokens / month
- Feature C (customer chat): 60M tokens / month
- Total: ~250M tokens / month (3M/month active users, avg 83 tokens per interaction)

2) Finance target: We’re hoping to keep inference costs under $350 / 1M tokens for the pilot — long term target is $200 / 1M if we scale.

3) CAC / payback: Current internal target is 6–9 months payback on new logo. LTV:CAC target ~3.5x.

Procurement note: we typically need a 30-day lead time for SOW review and they’ll want a basic security questionnaire answered (SOC2 evidence will be requested).

Emma
Emma Zhao | Head of Product Integrations
FinSolve Inc.
emma@finsolve.com

Perfect — that’s super helpful, Emma. We’ll model both pilot and scale targets. Quick thoughts (I’ll hand to Rishi for numbers but wanted to capture the ask):

- With 250M tokens/month pilot and your $350 / 1M target, raw inference spend at parity would be ~$87,500 / month (250 * 350 / 1). We can likely get to ~$200 / 1M at scale via batching + quantization and a dedicated pool; that brings run-rate to ~$50,000 / month.

- For CAC payback: if your target is 6–9 months, we need to show cost per feature (how much incremental inference cost we add per new customer) and gross margin after inference.

Action for us: Rishi will produce a per-feature marginal cost table ($/1K tokens and extrapolated to $/customer-month), plus suggested packaging tiers that help you hit a 3.5x LTV:CAC. I’ll also prepare a short SOW draft for procurement.

I’ll attach a quick workbook (FS_inference_model_v1.xlsx) with the assumptions above — Rishi, flag anything you disagree with.

Thanks,
Soojin

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + ask: token volumes, $/1M target, CAC payback

Emma / Soojin — ran quick back-of-envelope and updated the attached workbook with a per-feature breakdown. Key assumptions in the sheet:
- Baseline hosted price (unoptimized) = $400 / 1M tokens.
- Pilot optimizations (batching + prefix cache) reduce effective cost by ~20% -> $320 / 1M.
- Dedicated + quantization path reduces to $180–220 / 1M at scale depending on 8-bit vs 4-bit quantization.

Per-feature marginal cost (monthly):
- Feature A (summarization): 150M tokens -> at pilot $320/1M = $48k/mo. At scale $200/1M = $30k/mo.
- Feature B (triage): 40M tokens -> pilot $12.8k/mo, scale $8k/mo.
- Feature C (chat): 60M tokens -> pilot $19.2k/mo, scale $12k/mo.

Per-new-customer estimate (example):
- If an average new customer drives 500k tokens/month across features, at $320/1M the incremental inference cost ~ $160/month. On a 6–9 month payback window, your allowed CAC to meet 3.5x LTV:CAC depends on gross margin. If we target 60% gross margin post-inference, LTV contribution per customer/year = (revenue - inference cost) approximated in the workbook.

Recommendation summary:
1) Pilot price guidance: offer a blended meter at $300–320/1M with a 90-day pilot commitment and 30% usage discount to accelerate adoption.
2) Scale price guidance: contract a dedicated pool; target $180–220/1M depending on quantization & committed volume.
3) Packaging: include an add-on for 'real-time SLA' (higher price per 1M tokens) and a 'best-effort' tier for low-cost asynchronous jobs.

I’ve uploaded FS_inference_model_v1.xlsx (tab: assumptions & per-customer). Emma — if you want, I can convert the per-customer lines into a single-slide one-pager for your CFO.

-Rishi
